name: Conobe Mail Logger
author: benhall14

sections.installation:
1. Install Conobe Mail Logger either via the WordPress.org plugin repository or by uploading the files to your server.
  2. Activate Conobe Mail Logger.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes, Conobe Mail Logger logs all emails sent by WooCommerce, including order confirmations, customer notifications and admin emails.

Does it work with SMTP plugins?

Yes, Conobe Mail Logger works alongside SMTP plugins and logs emails sent via the standard wp_mail() function, which is used by the vast majority of WordPress plugins.

Does it log failed emails?

Yes, any errors returned while attempting to send an email are recorded in the email log.

Can I resend emails?

Yes, you can resend previously logged emails directly from the email log.

Will this slow my website?

No, Conobe Mail Logger is lightweight and designed to have minimal impact on your website’s performance.

Does it store attachments?

Yes. Attachments are stored alongside the email log so you can view or resend emails exactly as they were originally sent.

Can I search email logs?

Yes, you can quickly search your email history to find specific messages.

Is it GDPR friendly?

Yes, you remain in full control of your email logs and can manage or delete logged data to meet your GDPR requirements. There is also a ‘Remove on uninstall’ option that clears all logs.

Support

Please open a new support thread and provide as much information as possible.

Where can I report a bug?

Please open a new support thread and provide as much information as possible.

sections.description:
Log, monitor, search, and resend every email sent from your WordPress site. Quickly diagnose delivery issues, debug errors, and track history.

Never lose track of your WordPress emails again

Conobe Mail Logger records every email your WordPress website sends, giving you complete visibility into outgoing mail.

Whether you’re troubleshooting contact form submissions, WooCommerce order emails, password reset emails or membership notifications, you’ll always know exactly what was sent and whether WordPress encountered any errors.

Simply install and activate the plugin—logging starts immediately with no configuration required.

Features

  • Logs every outgoing email
  • View complete email content
  • Inspect email headers
  • View attachments
  • Record send failures
  • Search email history
  • Resend any email
  • View HTML and plain text versions
  • Automatically starts logging after activation
  • Lightweight with minimal performance impact

Why use Conobe Mail Logger?

Diagnose email delivery issues

Verify WooCommerce emails were generated

Confirm contact forms are sending

Audit emails sent from your website

Keep records for customer support

Reduce support time when emails go missing

What is logged?

• Subject
• Sender
• Recipient(s)
• CC / BCC
• Reply-To
• HTML body
• Plain text body
• Headers
• Attachments
• Date & time
• Error messages
• Optional server IP

Why aren’t my emails being sent?

Conobe Mail Logger records emails as they’re passed to WordPress for sending. This confirms that your website generated the email successfully and records any errors returned by WordPress or your mail provider. While successful logging doesn’t guarantee inbox delivery, it makes diagnosing email issues significantly easier.

Works with

Works seamlessly with:

• WooCommerce
• Contact Form 7
• WPForms
• Gravity Forms
• Fluent Forms
• Easy Digital Downloads
• LearnDash
• BuddyPress
• MemberPress
• The Events Calendar

…and virtually any plugin that uses the standard WordPress wp_mail() function.

Credits

This plugin is created and maintained by Conobe.
